description: Final enrichment for boardgame logs: geo, UA parsing, derived fields

script.description: Bucket latency so dashboards can group without a runtime field
script.source: if (ctx.event != null && ctx.event.duration_ms != null) { long d = ((Number) ctx.event.duration_ms).longValue(); if (d < 100) { ctx.event.latency_bucket = 'fast'; } else if (d < 500) { ctx.event.latency_bucket = 'normal'; } else if (d < 2000) { ctx.event.latency_bucket = 'slow'; } else { ctx.event.latency_bucket = 'critical'; } }
